gene_list.name: HLA Class II DR Beta 1
gene_list.disease_evidence: Strongest genetic association with SLE. DRB1*03:01 and *15:01 alleles confer 2-3x increased risk.

gene_list.name: Interferon Regulatory Factor 5
gene_list.disease_evidence: Key regulator of the type I interferon signature. Risk haplotype associated with high serum IFN-α activity.

gene_list.name: Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 4
gene_list.disease_evidence: Risk variant rs7574865 associated with increased STAT4 expression and SLE susceptibility.

gene_list.name: B Lymphoid Tyrosine Kinase
gene_list.disease_evidence: Reduced BLK expression in B cells impairs tolerance checkpoints and promotes autoantibody production.

gene_list.name: TNF Alpha Induced Protein 3 (A20)
gene_list.disease_evidence: Loss-of-function variants reduce negative regulation of NF-κB, promoting chronic inflammation.

gene_list.name: Integrin Subunit Alpha M (CD11b)
gene_list.disease_evidence: Missense variants (R77H) impair phagocytosis of apoptotic cells and immune complexes.

gene_list.name: B Cell Scaffold Protein with Ankyrin Repeats 1
gene_list.disease_evidence: Associated with SLE through variants affecting B cell hyperresponsiveness.

gene_list.name: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatase Non-Receptor Type 22
gene_list.disease_evidence: R620W gain-of-function variant alters T cell selection thresholds and promotes autoimmunity.

gene_list.name: TNF Superfamily Member 4 (OX40 Ligand)
gene_list.disease_evidence: Upregulated in SLE; promotes T follicular helper responses and autoantibody production.

gene_list.name: Fc Gamma Receptor IIa (CD32a)
gene_list.disease_evidence: H131R polymorphism alters IgG binding affinity and immune complex clearance, increasing lupus nephritis risk.

gene_list.name: Fc Gamma Receptor IIIa (CD16a)
gene_list.disease_evidence: V158F polymorphism affects IgG binding and is associated with SLE susceptibility.

gene_list.name: Toll-Like Receptor 7
gene_list.disease_evidence: Gene duplication and gain-of-function mutations cause lupus in mice and humans. Key driver of the IFN signature.

gene_list.name: Toll-Like Receptor 9
gene_list.disease_evidence: Recognizes DNA-containing immune complexes; contributes to anti-dsDNA antibody production.

gene_list.name: B Cell Activating Factor (TNFSF13B / BLyS)
gene_list.disease_evidence: Elevated serum BAFF levels in SLE patients. Direct therapeutic target of belimumab. Overexpression drives autoantibody production.

gene_list.name: Interferon Alpha and Beta Receptor Subunit 1
gene_list.disease_evidence: Key mediator of the interferon signature. Therapeutic target of anifrolumab.

gene_list.name: Janus Kinase 1
gene_list.disease_evidence: Required for IFN-α/β, IL-6, and other proinflammatory cytokine signaling. Target of baricitinib and tofacitinib in SLE trials.

gene_list.name: Tyrosine Kinase 2
gene_list.disease_evidence: Protective loss-of-function variants associated with reduced SLE risk. Selective TYK2 inhibitors in development.

gene_list.name: Bruton Tyrosine Kinase
gene_list.disease_evidence: BTK inhibition reduces B cell activation, autoantibody production, and kidney damage in lupus models.

gene_list.name: Complement C1q A Chain
gene_list.disease_evidence: Homozygous C1q deficiency is the strongest monogenic cause of SLE (>90% penetrance). C1q opsonizes apoptotic debris; deficiency leads to accumulation of self-antigen and loss of tolerance.

gene_list.name: Complement C2
gene_list.disease_evidence: C2 deficiency is one of the most common complement deficiencies associated with SLE (~10-20% of homozygous deficient develop SLE). Associated with anti-Ro/SSA antibodies and photosensitivity.

gene_list.name: Complement C4A
gene_list.disease_evidence: C4A copy number variation (low gene copy number) is strongly associated with SLE. Low C4A levels impair immune complex clearance and waste disposal. Gene copy number <2 confers ~3-6x risk.

gene_list.name: Interferon Regulatory Factor 7
gene_list.disease_evidence: IRF7 risk variants associated with increased IFN-α production and SLE susceptibility. IRF7 is essential for the TLR7/TLR9 → IFN-α axis in pDCs. Gain-of-function variants identified in familial SLE.

gene_list.name: Interleukin-1 Receptor-Associated Kinase 4
gene_list.disease_evidence: IRAK4 is critical for TLR7/TLR9-driven IFN-α and autoantibody production in lupus models. Pharmacological IRAK4 inhibition reduces disease severity in murine lupus.

gene_list.name: Myeloid Differentiation Primary Response 88
gene_list.disease_evidence: MyD88 is essential for TLR7/TLR9-mediated B cell activation and autoantibody production. MyD88-deficient lupus-prone mice are protected from disease. A central signaling hub in the lupus IFN pathway.

gene_list.name: IKAROS Family Zinc Finger 1 (IKAROS)
gene_list.disease_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE across multiple ancestries. IKZF1 variants alter lymphocyte development and promote autoimmunity through dysregulated B and T cell differentiation.

gene_list.name: IKAROS Family Zinc Finger 3 (AIOLOS)
gene_list.disease_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE. AIOLOS deficiency in mice leads to lupus-like disease with anti-dsDNA antibodies. Key regulator of plasma cell differentiation and humoral autoimmunity.

gene_list.name: TNFAIP3-Interacting Protein 1 (ABIN-1)
gene_list.disease_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE. TNIP1 risk variants reduce expression and impair A20-mediated NF-κB suppression. TNIP1-deficient mice develop lupus-like autoimmunity.

gene_list.name: Ubiquitin-Conjugating Enzyme E2 L3 (UBCH7)
gene_list.disease_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE and multiple autoimmune diseases. Risk allele increases UBE2L3 expression in B cells, enhancing NF-κB activation, plasma cell differentiation, and autoantibody production.

gene_list.name: Engulfment and Cell Motility 1
gene_list.disease_evidence: GWAS-implicated specifically in lupus nephritis. ELMO1 variants associated with increased risk of renal involvement in SLE. Promotes macrophage-mediated clearance of apoptotic cells in the kidney.

gene_list.name: PR/SET Domain 1 (BLIMP-1)
gene_list.disease_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE. PRDM1 risk variants alter Blimp-1 expression in B cells, dysregulating plasma cell differentiation and autoantibody production. Elevated Blimp-1+ plasma cells in SLE.

gene_list.name: Blood Dendritic Cell Antigen 2 (CLEC4C)
gene_list.disease_evidence: BDCA2 is the target of litifilimab (anti-BDCA2 mAb, Phase 3). Binding BDCA2 on pDCs inhibits TLR7/TLR9-mediated IFN-α production, reducing the type I interferon signature at its cellular source.

gene_list.name: B Cell Maturation Antigen (TNFRSF17)
gene_list.disease_evidence: BCMA is the target of teclistamab (BCMAxCD3 bispecific antibody). Depleting BCMA+ long-lived plasma cells may eliminate pathogenic autoantibody-producing cells in lupus. Case reports of drug-free remission after plasma cell depletion in SLE.

gene_list.name: CD19 (B-lymphocyte surface antigen)
gene_list.disease_evidence: CD19 is the target of anti-CD19 CAR-T cell therapy. Case series (n=5-8) showed drug-free remission in severe refractory SLE after CD19 CAR-T, with B cell reconstitution of naïve phenotype (Nature Medicine 2022).

gene_list.name: Autophagy Related 5
gene_list.disease_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE. ATG5 polymorphisms associated with SLE susceptibility. Autophagy dysregulation impairs T and B cell homeostasis, mitochondrial clearance, and promotes type I IFN production.
